purpose: Use Scanlon & Scanlon as a pedagogical completeness control for a Missal-reading course, not as the liturgical textual source of truth.

source.work: Cora Carroll Scanlon and Charles L. Scanlon, Latin Grammar: Grammar, Vocabularies, and Exercises in Preparation for the Reading of the Missal and Breviary

gate.rule: No v2 curriculum freeze until every P0 PARTIAL/MISSING row has an explicit lesson placement and assessment plan.

entries.evidence: Recurring pronunciation strand is absent; v1 has one read-aloud model.
entries.remediation: Build recurring stress/syllable/audio work across all stages.

entries.topic: First, second and third declensions; gender; neuters
entries.evidence: Core noun/adjective morphology is present and cumulative.
entries.remediation: Preserve; improve productive drill rather than add new exposition.

entries.evidence: Both are explicitly taught for reading recognition.
entries.remediation: Preserve and add production/retrieval items.

entries.evidence: Agreement is taught early and re-used with participles.
entries.remediation: Preserve.

entries.evidence: Person/number and voice recognition are taught, but not the complete four-conjugation system.
entries.remediation: Add permanent verb map and full regular-conjugation reference.

entries.topic: esse, posse, ire across core tenses
entries.evidence: High-frequency forms occur, but the complete systematic paradigms are not taught.
entries.remediation: Add structured irregular-verb reference and retrieval drills.

entries.evidence: Structured paradigms are authored and v2 exposes them.
entries.remediation: Preserve and add cumulative retrieval.

entries.evidence: Imperfect reading is taught; full active/passive conjugational coverage is not.
entries.remediation: Expand within verb map and add passive imperfect transfer items.

entries.evidence: Frequent liturgical commands are taught, not the complete regular/irregular system.
entries.remediation: Add systematic forms while retaining liturgical anchors.

entries.evidence: Future recognition is taught, but passive and complete paradigms are not comprehensive.
entries.remediation: Add full future patterns to verb map.

entries.evidence: Perfect participles and gerundive/gerund are taught; participial system is incomplete.
entries.remediation: Add present/future participles and full verbal-adjective map where Missal frequency warrants.

entries.evidence: Perfect active/passive are taught; pluperfect and future perfect are not systematically covered.
entries.remediation: Add complete perfect-system recognition and principal-parts strategy.

entries.evidence: Core government is explicitly taught and recycled.
entries.remediation: Preserve; add transfer items.

entries.evidence: Prayer uses and recognition are taught, not full conjugational paradigms.
entries.remediation: Integrate full mood/voice recognition into verb map.

entries.evidence: Prayer-oriented jussive/optative reading is explicit.
entries.remediation: Preserve with better transfer assessment.

entries.topic: ut/ne purpose and alternative purpose constructions
entries.evidence: ut/ne and gerund(ive) purpose are present; relative-purpose/causa/infinitive coverage is incomplete.
entries.remediation: Complete Missal-relevant purpose alternatives.

entries.evidence: Families are explicitly contrasted.
entries.remediation: Preserve and strengthen production.

entries.evidence: Recognition is taught in cum clauses; full active/passive system is not.
entries.remediation: Add full paradigm and clause-transfer drills.

entries.evidence: Purpose/result contrast is explicit.
entries.remediation: Preserve; tighten terminology in later curriculum rewrite.

entries.evidence: No dedicated treatment in the 40-lesson course.
entries.remediation: Add to Stage 5/6 after interrogatives and subjunctive foundations.

entries.evidence: Circumstantial cum is taught, but distinctions are compressed.
entries.remediation: Separate temporal/background, causal and concessive reading cues.

entries.evidence: No systematic conditional syntax.
entries.remediation: Add Missal/Vulgate-relevant conditionals and imperfect/pluperfect subjunctive contrast.

entries.evidence: Forms occur, but no systematic morphology unit exists.
entries.remediation: Add to permanent verb map rather than a standalone classical lesson.

entries.evidence: Passive morphology with active meaning is explicitly taught.
entries.remediation: Preserve.

entries.evidence: No explicit treatment.
entries.remediation: Add recognition note and high-frequency examples if corpus audit confirms value.

entries.evidence: Relative families and reader-toolkit interrogatives/indefinites are present.
entries.remediation: Preserve; add double-question extension.

entries.evidence: Listed as a reader-toolkit irregular, but not conjugated systematically.
entries.remediation: Add high-frequency forms to irregular verb reference.

entries.evidence: Form, function and diagnostic are explicit.
entries.remediation: Preserve with unseen transfer.

entries.evidence: fiat/fio is taught, but Scanlon's broader irregular tense treatment is absent.
entries.remediation: Add relevant fio/fieri forms to irregular verb map.

entries.evidence: Accusative + infinitive and quia + finite clause are contrasted.
entries.remediation: Preserve and add production/transfer.

entries.evidence: No dedicated reading treatment.
entries.remediation: Add high-frequency ecclesiastical impersonals after indirect discourse.

entries.evidence: A note exists for unus/solus/totus/alius patterns; not drilled systematically.
entries.remediation: Add compact reference and retrieval rather than a full lesson.

entries.evidence: Recipient/reference and selected advanced uses are present; Scanlon's full range is not.
entries.remediation: Corpus-rank possession, purpose, agent and verb-governed datives and teach those that matter.

entries.evidence: No systematic comparative/superlative morphology or syntax.
entries.remediation: Add frequency-driven comparison module; needed for broad independent reading.

entries.evidence: volo/nolo appear as irregulars; the system and noli/nolite command are not systematically taught.
entries.remediation: Add to irregular verb reference and command syntax.

entries.evidence: Government and selected means/content uses are present; broader functions are compressed.
entries.remediation: Corpus-rank accompaniment, agent, cause, manner, means, place, separation and time.

entries.evidence: nonne/numquid/quomodo are covered; enclitic -ne and double-question systems are not.
entries.remediation: Add compact question-particle system and transfer passages.

entries.evidence: No explicit treatment.
entries.remediation: Add only corpus-relevant defective forms to irregular reference.

entries.topic: Accusative duration of time / extent of space
entries.evidence: No systematic treatment.
entries.remediation: Add if corpus frequency justifies; otherwise reference-only.

entries.evidence: No systematic appendix-equivalent reference.
entries.remediation: Build digital reference; teach only high-frequency forms actively.

entries.evidence: Authentic passages are authored and v2 now displays them, but sustained assessed reading is too sparse.
entries.remediation: Create stage reading lessons and make connected reading compulsory evidence.

entries.evidence: Core 350 exists, but vocabulary is over-front-loaded and lacks Scanlon-style mastery/recognition/support tiering.
entries.remediation: Rebuild lexicon tiers from Core 350 × Scanlon regular/derivative model × 1962 corpus frequency.

notes: FULL means adequate reading coverage exists in the authored course, not that current exercises are sufficient.
PARTIAL means the concept exists but is narrower or less systematic than the Scanlon reading-grammar benchmark.
MISSING does not automatically mean a new standalone lesson; corpus frequency decides lesson, micro-unit, or reference-only treatment.
The full Breviary lexicon is outside the core Ad Orientem Missal-course target and may become a later extension.
